title: Insert and delete commands that can undo themselves

cases.says: Two inserts build "Hello World", a delete removes " World", and undoing the delete and then the second insert gives "Hello World" and "Hello".
Undoing an insert made in the middle of the text removes exactly that text from that position, even when the same text also appears later.
If the text changes between building a DeleteCommand and executing it, undo restores what execute() really deleted.
undo() on a DeleteCommand that never ran throws IllegalStateException and leaves the text as it was.
